correctness.rationale: The product quotient geometry gives the stated subdivided K4,4 incidence, 24 rational components, 32 distinct transverse nodes and genus 9. For the fixed root C00, a 23-square reduced Laplacian presents K; graph monodromy duality turns fixed groups into duals of coinvariant cokernels. The dependency-free certificate independently evaluates the nine orbit matrices and 23-by-46 presentations using exact Bareiss determinants and mod-2^32 unimodular reduction; all matrix orders are powers of 2. An explicit integral vector with Rx=32e_H0 and x_H0=23 proves the invariant class has exact order 32, while the four-generator coinvariant matrix proves the full invariant group has order 32. Symbolic proof covers all possible elliptic Frob conjugacy types, not merely enumerated fields.

value.rationale: The 24-curve double Kummer pencil is an intrinsic and classical rational-curve boundary on product Kummer K3 surfaces. The nine complete finite abelian Frobenius-fixed groups refine the ordinary graph critical group and provide genuinely integral arithmetic descent data. The uniform full S3×S3 invariant C32 generated by an explicit natural geometric divisor difference is a structural result not obtainable from incidence counts or group orders alone. A conditional relation to degeneration component groups provides plausible use, without assuming an unproved smoothing existence theorem.
